question: Do the source actors retain recovery for 55 seconds after the 5 kg / 1.3 m/s chest hit, or does the 12-second screen hide delayed failure?
decision: Require 64/64 recovery, every shot Chest-first without Head, and all backend comparisons passing before claiming sustained recovery at this dose. Retain all delayed failures and do not equate a 12-second pass with 60-second recovery.
